name: Shenzhen Hopewind Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Hopewind Electric Co., Ltd. provides green power solutions worldwide. It engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of energy and electrical fields. The company also provides solar inverters, including PV grid-tied inverters and turnkey solutions; energy storage systems, such as power conversion system and PCS turkey station products; and wind power devices, such as doubly-fed and full power converters, and pitch control systems.
